elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your Android can stay awake while you're looking at it.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Screen attention.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Display and touch. Tap Screen timeout, then switch on Screen attention. On a Samsung, it's Keep screen on while viewing.

[delighted] Now it stays on while you read, and sleeps when you walk away.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
